brandColors.usage: Default page: the brand guideline's white pages; card ground on a cream page
Light page and card fill: the guideline's cream; office cards and grid paper
Primary dark: header bands, plates, tabs, scrims and titles on a light page; the ground of evening or dark invitations and keynote screens
Royal indigo: band gradients, plates, and accent lines on a light page
Blue: secondary lines, rules and icons
Bright blue: one highlight at most, sparingly
Gold: thin rules, frames, borders and the title's accent line on indigo; never text on white or cream
Body ink on a light page, as the guideline sets its body text
